scope: Current simple local product; specification gaps only; no implementation or evidence claim.

gaps.title: Complete product and internal API operation contracts
gaps.already_defined: One local workspace; same-origin internal calls; preserved domain schemas, selected submission statuses and private media. No public API/SDK, login/account endpoints or tenant setup is required.
gaps.missing_definition: The minimal interface/service operation inventory still lacks exact method/path, payloads, required/nullable fields, limits, headers, revision preconditions, pagination where needed, idempotency scope, success/error outcomes and atomic effects for local preparation, review, publication, answers/results, disputes, import, settings, media and speech.
gaps.answer_needed: Engineering should define each remaining internal operation and remove superseded account/tenant/admin API rows. Specify request/response fields, validation, statuses and state/DB/media effects; ordinary users configure no API.
gaps.closure_positive: Every in-scope operation has one versioned request/response/security/error contract and links to its flow and owner.
gaps.closure_negative: An omitted operation, undefined payload/status or unbound route prevents an API-complete claim.
gaps.current_scope: Define only minimal internal UI/service and local import/recovery operations; remove login/account/tenant/admin/public SDK endpoints and authentication headers.
gaps.why_it_matters: The interface needs an unambiguous contract for every action so the browser, backend and speech service agree on what to save and return. This concerns private implementation calls, not a public API product.
